Alder 3 Burr Coffee Grinder

A consistent grind makes better coffee, and the Alder 3 gives you one every morning. Its hardened steel conical burr cuts beans evenly instead of crushing them, which gives balanced extraction and cleaner flavor for espresso, pour-over, or French press.

The 40 grind settings run from fine Turkish powder to coarse cold-brew grounds, so you can make small adjustments when your beans or recipe change. The 250-gram hopper holds several days of beans. Fill it once and skip the daily measuring.

The grinder runs quietly and feels solid on the counter. It takes apart easily for cleaning, and its compact body fits small kitchens.

It comes with a 2-year warranty and costs $219.
